# `Scanner/T2Decay-v0` · T2 of marked vials from spin echoes

**A · Signal and contrast** · spins and relaxation · kind 1, measure · isolates A5: T2: decay of the transverse magnetisation, seen with a spin echo. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** CANDIDATE: the gate has not been run (no stored result)

Subject A (signal and contrast), a single-skill measurement: T2 decay of the spin echo. Every echo time is a scan of its own. The slope of ln(signal) against echo time is -1 / T2 only if the recovery before the excitation is the same in every scan and the echoes at the noise floor are left out.

Kind of task: **undetermined** (no stored gate result).

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (a disc of gel with vials), 1.5 T
- Sequences that matter here: se
- Formulas the agent is given: S = M0 (1 - 2 E(TR - TE/2) + E(TR)) exp(-TE / T2) for ideal pulses (datasheet section 5); the served signal is the pulse chain integrated over the profiles of both pulses of the 2D slice

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |

| T2, T1, proton density and T2' of every material | region centres and radii |
| geometry of body and vials | the range of T2 (level 1: 40 to 200 ms; level 2: 40 to 200 ms; level 3: 15 to 400 ms) and of T1 (300 to 2500 ms) |
| transmit gain and B1 pattern | the pass tolerance |
| receive profile | level 1: the method |
| noise level | the instrument datasheet |
| the 128-bit world seed | budget and request limits |
|  | realised protocol, timing and cost of every plan and scan |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'t2_ms': {'<region id>': '<milliseconds>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; deliverable valid: exactly the region ids, values in 2 to 5000 ms
- Error: `largest over the regions of |ln(T2_delivered / T2_true)|`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates and, for every region, error <= ln(1.1)

## Gate: the control policies on fresh instances

**Gate not stored on this engine** (`mrgym-engine-0.3.0`). `mrgym gate Scanner/T2Decay-v0 --n 300 --write` measures and stores it.

| Policy | Must | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `reference` | pass | echo times with the recovery held fixed (tr_ms = TR0 + 0.75 x te_ms), a line through ln(signal), echoes at the noise floor left out |
| `prior` | fail | no scan; the geometric mean of the told T2 range in every region |
| `fixed_recipe` | fail | one token scan, then one constant T2 tuned on other worlds |
| `one_image` | fail | one scan at te_ms 80; T2 from the brightness alone, the brightest region taken as the reference |
| `brute_force` | fail | a ladder of echo times at one repetition time; the first echo time with the signal below 1 / e of the first echo, no fit |
| `wrong_units` | fail | the reference's T2 in seconds |
| `fixed_tr` | ablation | the reference's echo times at one repetition time (the recovery differs between the echoes) |
| `no_floor` | ablation | the reference's scans, the line fitted through every echo (none left out at the noise floor) |
| `open_loop` | reported | the reference (a fixed list of scans, a fixed estimator) |
| `adaptive` | reported | level 3: two echo times first, two more placed from what they show (elsewhere the reference) |
| `ideal_pulses` | reported | the reference with tr_ms = TR0 + te_ms (the rule for ideal pulses) |
| `coarse` | reported | the reference on a 32 matrix with partial_fourier 0.6 |
| `short_echoes` | reported | the reference with the echo times 12, 20 and 30 ms |

## What the agent reads at reset (level 2, seed 0)

~~~text
# Measure T2 of each marked vial
A test object with vials of unknown materials lies in the field of view.
Deliver the transverse relaxation time T2 of each marked region, in milliseconds, with `submit`.
Regions (circles; centre and radius in mm from the isocentre; each lies inside one homogeneous material):
  R1: y 1.23, x -2.68, radius 11.5
  R2: y -54.15, x 0.51, radius 11.5
  R3: y 0.14, x 53.01, radius 11.5
T2 values lie between 40 and 200 ms, T1 values between 300 and 2500 ms.
Nothing else about the object or the system is known.
One `se` scan gives one echo time: the scanner has no multi-echo spin echo.

Passing: for every region the delivered T2 lies within a factor 1.1 of the true T2 (between T2 / 1.1 and 1.1 x T2).
The scanner's log must show that you measured. An answer in the wrong unit is wrong.

Limits. Scan time: 85 s (only `scan` spends it). Tool calls: 48 (every call counts once unless rejected). Rejected calls: 8 (a call refused for how it is written: unknown name, wrong type; costs nothing else), of them at most 3 refused `submit` calls. The episode ends at `submit` or at a limit; without `submit` the score is 0.
[scan time left 85.00 of 85 s · calls 0/48 · rejected 0/8]
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier reads the hidden T2 and scans nothing.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
